title: I-Echo Edlula Emaweni
intro: Khawuthelekelele intlambo apho izindlu zigrunjwe ngamawa, kwaye umoya ugcina inkumbulo yesilumkiso esingathotyelwanga. Abantu ababekhe bachuma apha, besikelelekile kodwa bengenamdla, de kwavela uphawu kwiliwa ababelithemba.
clues: Sasingabantu ababeziqwenga izindlu ezikhuselekileyo ezintabeni, beziva bekhuselekile kwiindawo zethu zokuhlala ezinamatye.
Sasihlala kwilizwe elinamathafa namatye, elisikelelwe ziigadi nemithombo yamanzi.
Kwafika isithunywa esivela phakathi kwethu, sisibiza ukuba silahle oothixo bethu bobuxoki size sinqule uMdali oyinyaniso omnye.
Ngokuzikhukhumeza sibeka ummiselo wokukholelwa: uphawu olukhethekileyo oluya kuvela kumatye esiwaqobileyo.
Xa inkamela yemazi eyayithenjisiwe yavela eliweni, uphawu olucacileyo, abantu abaphezulu bethu basala baza bayinqumla imisipha nangona babelumkisiwe ngentshabalalo ezayo.
Emva kweentsuku ezintathu senze into esiyithethileyo, kwavakala isandi esikhulu entlanjeni, saza sadilika saba yinkunkuma, amakhaya ethu aba ngamangcwaba ethu.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
